Searches for GST turnover / GeM / CPPP tenders returned no results (search backend unavailable: "searx: Connection refused"); zaubacorp, thecompanycheck and volza returned HTTP 403. note: Actual export shipments are confirmed by dated Indian customs records: 28.11.2025, Nhava Sheva Sea -> Jebel Ali (UAE), buyer CHEMSOL TRADING L.L.C (group company in Dubai), B/L 4575741 and 7030740. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS 820713 / 841989 / 847982 (metallurgy/mining equipment) does not match the actual shipped goods, which are epoxy/polyurethane resins and masking tape under HS 39073010, 39075000, 39199090. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, actual HS codes should be corrected to 39073010 / 39075000 / 39199090, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claim "Металлургия и горнодобыча" is also unsupported by shipment content - actual profile is polymer/epoxy resin and adhesive-tape manufacturing (MIDC Jejuri, Pune, Maharashtra). Role: manufacturer (own plant address in customs record) with related-party trading arm in UAE. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null - not public in the free view. Domestic (India) supply evidence: not found in accessible sources, so domestic_status = unknown, not 'confirmed'. Caveat: 429 claimed records vs 5 rows actually seen - the free view is a sample, so the full shipment history is not independently verifiable here.
